claim_boundary: CPU algebraic known-answer only. This verifies gauge-null and rank accounting for matrix-product and CP programs; it does not establish identifiability, semantic meaning, causal sufficiency, or minimality of any bilin18 replacement.

algebraic_matroid_basis.interpretation: At this regular CP point, 39 selected physical tensor entries span the differentials of all 120 entries. This is local and first-order, not a global identifiability certificate.

duplicate_component_failure_control.interpretation: Coincident CP components are a singular, non-identifiable point; the Jacobian loses directions beyond the ordinary per-component scaling gauge.
